supersedes_audit: docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md §22.75 (BLOCKED audit) — this artifact freezes every item that was UNFROZEN there

final_trace_population.diversity: five full-length native Mahimahi families spanning Verizon EVDO/LTE, ATT LTE and TMobile LTE/UMTS; no further strata are required beyond this frozen population
final_trace_population.duplicate_families: not allowed; each family is counted once
final_trace_population.current_trace_status: Verizon-EVDO-driving and Verizon-LTE-driving are retained as population members (their existing evidence is reused); no double counting

trace_eligibility: genuine mm-link EOF/endpoint validation must pass (protocol-v2 endpoint evidence)
no trace contamination according to the existing checks (epoch.ExclusionTraceContamination and anchor_alignment)
technical execution failures may be rerun under the same protocol
a scientifically ineligible trace is not silently replaced
no post-hoc trace substitution based on observed H

replay_oracle_rules.transport: protocol-v2 watchdog-only (request deadline none, dial deadline none, parent/child watchdog 45 m)
replay_oracle_rules.http: HTTP/1.1 only; one request = one contiguous byte range
replay_oracle_rules.replay: full-trace uninterrupted fixed-C replay; continuous backlog; trace time t=0 to EOF
replay_oracle_rules.measurement: timestamped byte-delivery events mapped through the frozen trace-time anchor (StartupOffset 60 ms, AlignmentTolerance 100 ms)
replay_oracle_rules.shared_validity: any invalid C invalidates the epoch for all C
replay_oracle_rules.regime_classifier: exact existing classifier (native downlink only; full 120 s epochs; k=max(1,floor(n/3)); degraded=k lowest; good=k highest not degraded; recovering=rate[e]>=1.25*rate[e-1] and not degraded; precedence degraded>recovering>good>middle)
replay_oracle_rules.injection_selection: exact existing rule: per regime (degraded,good,recovering) earliest full epoch and, if available, the next distinct one
replay_oracle_rules.ladder: 1<->2<->4<->8<->16; at most one step per epoch boundary; no direct jumps
replay_oracle_rules.dwell: after a change at boundary e, C_{e+1}=C_e (at least one complete following epoch)

protocol_amendment.reason: the frozen switch-injection harness cannot represent the mathematical boundary t = 0: the child applies a scheduled switch only when SwitchAt > 0 and treats SwitchAt = 0 as 'no switch'
protocol_amendment.original_boundary_zero_specification: injection_selection selects, per regime in the order degraded, good, recovering, the earliest full epoch and, if available, the next distinct one; for ATT-LTE-driving the good regime's earliest full epoch is epoch 0 with start_ms = 0, which is part of the frozen ATT 4 x 8 = 32 matrix

boundary_zero_rule.applies_to: any preregistered injection timestamp of exactly 0 ms (currently only ATT-LTE-driving good epoch 0)
boundary_zero_rule.execution: start at the source C; apply the switch at child-elapsed 1 ms; switch_applied must be recorded true; the target C governs the complete post-switch measurement window [0 ms, 120000 ms)
boundary_zero_rule.matrix_unchanged: ATT-LTE-driving 4 timestamps x 8 directions = 32 runs; total Stage-B matrix 88 runs
boundary_zero_rule.other_rules_unchanged: remaining three ATT timestamps, all 8 directions, estimator, classifier, dwell rule, epoch rule, and statistical gate are unchanged

tau_scope.rationale: tau is a transition-cost property of the replayed trace/environment; the existing two-trace tau measurements are reusable only for those two traces, so each newly added trace requires its own tau measurement rather than assuming pooled cross-trace transferability
tau_scope.estimator: retain signed raw observations; aggregate with the frozen median rule (regime-specific iff >=2 regimes with valid observations, all medians >0, max/min >= 2.0); formal tau = max(0, estimated tau)
tau_scope.estimator_frozen: must not be altered after seeing new results

statistical_design.population_estimator: arithmetic mean of the five trace-level H_j values
statistical_design.variability_estimator: ordinary sample standard deviation across the five H_j values
statistical_design.confidence_bound: one-sided 95% Student-t lower confidence bound; df = n-1 (n=5, df=4)

invalid_missing_handling: a technical run failure may be rerun under the same protocol
a trace failing a scientific eligibility criterion is not substituted or selectively deleted
do not evaluate the final statistical gate unless all five predefined trace families yield usable trace-level H values
if fewer than five usable traces remain, report the study as failing to reach the preregistered final-gate sample rather than changing n or replacing traces post hoc
notes: timestamp counts reuse the already verified classifier outputs (§22.75); no new timestamps are invented
the existing two-trace descriptive headroom (EVDO 1.6075%, LTE 0.0320%) is unchanged and is not a population estimate
this artifact contains no measured data
